reviews.text: The texture is so nice! It’s a creamy powder you can easily modulate to get a less or more natural look. Just like watercolour. It’s absolutely pretty 😍
reviews.zh: 質地超正！係一種 creamy 嘅粉狀質地，可以輕易調較，造出不同程度嘅自然妝感。就好似水彩咁。真係好靚 😍

reviews.text: This lip & cheek powder has a soft, airy texture that blends smoothly for a natural flush. **01 Peach Whip** gives a sweet peach tone that brightens the face gently. The My Melody packaging, acrylic charm, and sticker make it extra cute and collectible.
reviews.zh: 呢支唇頰粉質地柔軟輕盈，容易推開，可以造出自然嘅紅暈。**01 Peach Whip** 係一個甜桃色調，輕輕提亮成塊面。My Melody 嘅包裝、亞加力膠吊飾同貼紙都令佢更加得意，值得收藏。

reviews.text: This is like a kids toy makeup…
reviews.zh: 呢樣嘢似係細路仔玩具化妝品……

reviews.text: Love it! Easy to blend, looks super natural (as opposed to powders or creams, it somehow doesn't look or give off a "i'm wearing makeup texture"). The putty texture gives it a super natural finish. Love the color - just need to be careful when building it up to not over do it.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！容易推開，妝感超自然（比起粉狀或者膏狀，佢唔會有種「我喺化緊妝」嘅質感）。Putty 質地令妝感好自然。鍾意呢個顏色——只係要注意唔好疊得太多，唔係就好易過濃。

reviews.text: cute blush. this pink is a little too neon for me, but it has a good formula and blends easily. pigmented but easy to blend out to something more managable. It's very light white kind of pink so it's not good for darker skin tones.
reviews.zh: 得意嘅胭脂。呢個粉紅色對我嚟講有少少太 neon，但配方唔錯，容易推開。顯色但又易 blend 到比較自然嘅程度。係好淺嘅帶白粉紅色，所以唔適合深色肌。

reviews.text: Me encantó, me sorprendió mucho la textura porque se siente como si fuera terciopelo, yo pensé que sería en polvo pero es como si fuera crema. Se trabaja muy bien, tiene buena picmentacion, se difumina sin problema, y se mezcla bien con otros productos.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，質地令我好驚喜，因為感覺好似天鵝絨咁，我以為會係粉狀，但係好似膏狀。好好用，顯色度好，blend 得好順，同其他產品都好易 mix。

reviews.text: I love this little blush, and the keyring that came with it is so cute too! I don’t fully understand the use of the packaging as I wouldn’t need to clip my blush on anything, but that might just be me!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個細細個嘅胭脂，附送嘅 keyring 都好得意！對個包裝嘅用途有少少唔明白，因為我冇嘢需要扣住個胭脂，但可能只係我自己嘅問題！

reviews.text:
Muy lindo y versátil
Lo compré más que todo por el empaque (es precioso 😭), pero el producto también es muy bueno. Da un efecto natural tanto en labios como en mejillas. Perfecto para maquillaje ligero.
reviews.zh:
好靚又好用
主要係因為包裝先買嘅（真係好靚 😭），不過產品本身都好正。搽喺嘴唇或者面頰都可以做到自然效果。最適合化淡妝用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
